name: client-runtime-identity-account-address
executionConcern: client native/runtime lifecycle, Identity session isolation, account/address/map/privacy ownership
objective: Close app-client boot-to-owned-session and owned-address foundations so native transport, session recovery, account data and address/service-area/privacy state fail closed and cannot leak or retain another actor's truth.
truthOwner: Identity owns actor/auth/session/device-session binding; DSH owns client address/service-area/privacy operational truth; mobile runtime is transport only.
journeys: device restart/offline/recovery and push-token session hygiene

tasks.objective: Make native/mobile bootstrap and client transport deterministic and fail closed
tasks.currentProblem: Shared mobile/runtime scripts changed materially after the old package pin; a UI test cannot prove that LAN/host/env/native config, dev-client bootstrap, restart and dependency reachability select one correct runtime without stale ADB/localhost or silent fallback.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace app-client app.config/eas/env/start/mobile scripts through shared apps/mobile transport/runtime config; remove duplicate client-specific transport truth, keep one validated source for service endpoints, and make missing/unreachable dependencies explicit rather than fabricating readiness.
tasks.targetState: One client startup path resolves environment/host/service endpoints deterministically, rejects invalid config, survives restart, and never changes authorization or business truth to compensate for transport failure.
tasks.action: Correct shared runtime ownership first, then app-client wrappers/config and runtime-contract tests; preserve production/dev separation and secret boundaries.
mustNotChange: Do not make ADB reverse an authorization/business dependency.
Do not hardcode a developer machine IP as product truth.
Do not expose secrets through EXPO_PUBLIC values.
Do not add a second app-client-only endpoint resolver when shared runtime owns it.
acceptanceCriteria: LAN/dev-client restart reaches the same configured owners without stale localhost assumptions.
Native config and EAS/provider inputs remain contract-valid.
Transport failure never yields authenticated/business success.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving durable/audit evidence; never restore a parallel local truth or weaken a safety boundary.
tasks.commitBoundary: One U001 runtime-foundation commit or a clearly separated runtime subcommit before Identity/address changes; no unrelated mobile-app edits.

tasks.objective: Close client Identity/session isolation and stale-state invalidation
tasks.currentProblem: Current App.tsx wires SecureStore, device fingerprint, IdentitySessionGate and push registration, but static wiring does not prove activation surface binding, atomic refresh rotation, logout/relogin invalidation, wrong-role rejection, session outage recovery or that actor-scoped cached data is cleared.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace app-client Identity calls through generated client/session policy/store and Identity backend/database; repair the first divergence in actor/surface/trusted-context/session rotation/revocation, and invalidate client query/cache/push state when the session subject changes.
tasks.targetState: A client session is surface-bound and actor-owned; refresh/revocation/logout are authoritative; wrong role/surface and reused/expired tokens fail closed; no previous actor data survives session change or restart.
tasks.action: Fix Identity owner and persistence/contract first, then client session gate/storage/cache/push consumers and negative tests.
mustNotChange: Do not use device fingerprint as object authorization.
Do not accept actor/platform/operator context from mobile input.
Do not weaken role/surface validation for development.
Do not persist raw tokens or activation codes in logs/evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong role/surface and expired/reused sessions are denied.
Refresh rotation/revocation is atomic and logout/relogin clears previous actor state.
Identity outage is unavailable/recoverable, not anonymous success.
Push registration follows the active subject/session and is removed/rebound safely.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving durable/audit evidence; never restore a parallel local truth or weaken a safety boundary.
tasks.commitBoundary: Identity owner fix plus only directly affected app-client bindings/tests; no Workforce/partner/captain identity rewrite.

tasks.currentProblem: Address UI exists and map/address Product Truth reports prior code closure, but current candidate must still prove owner scope, active geofence binding, provider mediation, PII redaction, optimistic-state removal and account/address cache invalidation under actor changes.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace AddressLocation/account controllers through generated DSH map/address contracts, clientaddress/mapproviders/servicearea handlers and database constraints; repair owner/object isolation, topology/geofence validation, privacy retention/audit and canonical reload on mutation.
tasks.targetState: Every visible/usable client address belongs to the authenticated actor, resolves through DSH to an active service area, exposes only permitted PII, and every create/update/delete/select success is confirmed by committed DSH readback.
tasks.action: Fix DSH address/service-area/privacy owner and database invariants before UI mapping; limit control-panel work to map/service-area/privacy policy required by this path.
mustNotChange: Do not call external map providers directly from app-client.
Do not trust client-supplied service-area identity without server resolution.
Do not disclose another actor's address/location/phone/instructions.
Do not mark address mutation final before canonical reload.
acceptanceCriteria: Cross-actor address reads/writes are denied or hidden.
Malformed/provider-unavailable map results do not become address truth.
Delete/retention/privacy audit paths exclude raw PII where required.
Mutation success reloads exact persisted address/service-area version.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused unit commit or roll forward at the canonical owner while preserving durable/audit evidence; never restore a parallel local truth or weaken a safety boundary.
tasks.commitBoundary: DSH address/map/privacy canonical owner changes plus bounded app-client/control-platform consumer corrections only.
